title: Add the ability to enable / disable Pipewire RAOP/Airplay Discovery in System Settings - Audio
line: Sound settings now have a Configure… option to stop AirPlay devices on the network from showing up as outputs.
explanation: Fedora and some other distributions load PipeWire's RAOP discover module, which turns every AirPlay receiver on the network into an output; apps such as Steam then wake the receiver. The only way to turn it off was hand-writing a pipewire.conf.d file with module.raop = false and restarting. The Sound page now shows a Configure… menu on PipeWire when RAOP discovery is configured, with a checkbox that writes or removes ~/.config/pipewire/pipewire.conf.d/00-plasma-pa-raop.conf and restarts PipeWire, the same way Rename Devices applies its WirePlumber config.

commits.message:
kcm: add a setting for AirPlay device discovery on PipeWire

Some distributions load PipeWire's RAOP discover module, which adds every
AirPlay device on the network as an output with no way to turn it off but
a config file. Offer a toggle that writes that file and restarts PipeWire.

BUG: 523215

media.caption: Sound settings on PipeWire with RAOP discovery loaded: no setting for it
New Configure… menu with the AirPlay discovery checkbox (enabled)
After unchecking: PipeWire restarted without the RAOP discover module, the setting stays off

review.text: Toggling a menu checkbox that immediately runs `systemctl --user restart wireplumber.service pipewire.service` is an unacceptable UX and architectural trade-off: restarting `pipewire.service` without warning or an explicit Apply step terminates all active PipeWire audio, call, OBS, and Wayland screen-sharing/screencast streams desktop-wide, and assumes systemd with no fallback. The config-file implementation also has multiple defects: `00-plasma-pa-raop.conf` has the wrong `pipewire.conf.d` precedence (later fragments override earlier ones), `!QFile::exists()` ignores system/manual overrides such as `/etc/pipewire/pipewire.conf.d/`, naive substring grepping on the UI thread misses non-conditional module loads and hides the control on distros where RAOP is off by default (failing the 'enable' half of the request), and the UI adds a second gear-icon 'Configure…' button right beside 'Configure Volume Controls…'.
changes: Do not restart pipewire.service immediately from a popup menu checkbox; if a PipeWire restart is unavoidable it requires an explicit Apply/confirmation UX with a clear warning about interrupting audio and screen-sharing streams, and must not hardcode `systemctl` without error handling (`QProcess::errorOccurred` isn't even connected to `deleteLater`).
Use a `99-` filename (not `00-`) if writing a `pipewire.conf.d` override so it wins over distro fragments like `50-raop.conf`.

Support both enabling and disabling RAOP discovery (including distros that do not pre-load `libpipewire-module-raop-discover`) and determine actual state rather than relying on `!QFile::exists()` and synchronous substring grepping on the GUI thread.
Follow the VDG/network-audio design discussion referenced in the bug instead of placing a single PipeWire toggle in a second gear-icon 'Configure…' menu next to 'Configure Volume Controls…'.
